title: H0885 (2020 Regular): State Preemption of Firearm and Ammunition Regulation

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2019-12-09; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2020/885/BillText/Filed/PDF (LegiScan doc 2072958))
provenance.note: Introduced version (filed 2019-12-09); no passage vote. Paragraph (e) loses "or" and gains "; or".

operative_text:
Section 1 (s. 790.33, F.S.): (4) EXCEPTIONS.—This section does not prohibit:
Section 1 (s. 790.33, F.S.): (f) A county, agency, municipality, district, or other entity from adopting an ordinance that regulates the sale of firearms or ammunition on property that is owned by that county, agency, municipality, district, or other entity.
